claims.claim_ar: تكرار كلمة «أَيْدِيَهُمْ» (ظهورها مرتين) كوسيلة بديعية للتوكيد والتشديد على محاولة الاعتداء ثم إبطالها
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the word “أَيْدِيَهُمْ” (appearing twice) as a badi' device to emphasize and intensify the attempted aggression and its being checked
claims.needs_review_reason: The repetition is evident in the verse words provided, but none of the supplied source chunks explicitly discusses this repetition in relation to this ayah; verification against a balagha commentary is advised.
claims.rhetorical_effect: تأكيد الحدث وإبراز عاقبته (emphasis on the attempted aggression and its prevention)

claims.claim_ar: التفات في المخاطبة: بدء النداء بـ«يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» ثم الانتقال إلى سطر سردي عن حدث تاريخي («إذ هم قوم...»)، وهو التبدّل في طريقة الخطاب المعروف بالالتفات
claims.claim_en: Turn in address (iltifat): beginning with the vocative “O you who believe” and then shifting into a narrative recounting of a past event (“when a people intended…”), a rhetorical turn in the mode of address
claims.needs_review_reason: Identification of iltifat here is interpretive (shift of address to narrative); the provided source chunks do not explicitly analyze this ayah's shift of address, so the claim should be checked against specialized balagha tafsir.
claims.rhetorical_effect: يجذب انتباه المخاطبين ثم يربطهم بواقعة تاريخية لتدعيم التذكير (captures attention and links the audience to a historical example to strengthen the admonition)

claims.claim_ar: فاصل-وصل بين الطلب بالتذكرة («اذكروا نعمة الله عليكم») ثم توضيح السبب والحدث التاريخي («إذ هم قوم... فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عنكم») بواسطة أدوات الربط والفاء لتبيان تدخل الله وفعل العطف والنتيجة
claims.claim_en: Fasl-wasl (separation-and-connection): the admonition to remember Allah’s favor is followed by the explanatory historical event (“when a people... so He withheld their hands from you”) linked by connective particles (e.g., ف) to show divine intervention and consequent relation
claims.needs_review_reason: Reading this structure as an instance of fasl_wasl is plausible but somewhat subjective; the provided source chunks do not explicitly identify this rhetorical linkage for this ayah and further confirmation from balagha exegesis is recommended.
claims.rhetorical_effect: يبيّن العلاقة السببية والتدخّل الإلهي ليقوي أثر التذكير (clarifies causal relation and divine intervention to reinforce the reminder)
